The minimum UAV crew must be established so that it is sufficient for safe operation considering
(a) The workload on individual UAV crew members taking into account at least the following tasks:
  (1) Operation and monitoring of all essential UAV System elements,
  (2) Navigation,
  (3) Flight path control,
  (4) Communications,
  (5) Compliance with airspace, air traffic, and air traffic control requirements,
  (6) Command decisions including Crew resource management,
(b) The accessibility and ease of operation of necessary controls.

See AMC.U1704 The minimum UAS crew must be established so that it is sufficient for safe operation considering:
(a) The workload on individual UAS crew members taking into account at least the following tasks:
  (1) Operation and monitoring of all essential UAS elements,
  (2) Navigation,
  (3) Flight path control,
  (4) Communications,
  (5) Compliance with airspace, air traffic, and air traffic control requirements,
  (6) Command decisions including Crew resource management,
(b) The accessibility and ease of operation of necessary controls.
